top_signals.title: Skydance Bonds Extend Losses Amid Buyout Angst
top_signals.summary: Skydance Corp. bonds weakened further on Tuesday, and the cost of protecting the company’s debt against default jumped, as investors fretted about the profitability of the company after its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.

top_signals.title: OPEC Sees Oil Demand Growth Surging to 2.6 Million Bpd in 2027
top_signals.summary: OPEC just put a very large number on next year’s oil market: global demand growth of 2.6 million barrels per day in 2027, after growth of just 200,000 bpd this year. That would push average world oil demand from 105.7 million bpd in 2026 to 108.3 million bpd next year. OPEC also revised its 2027 demand forecast higher this month, even as it nudged this year’s growth estimate lower. Part of that jump has little to do with people suddenly driving a lot more.
